> 十六章 童趣（第1页）
沈玄曦之所以会与太子皇甫皓轩成为朋友，却是一件趣事。这件事，蓝若晴不知道缠着沈玄曦讲过多少次，每次都当作是故事来听，却是百听不厌。
一天，沈玄曦偷溜出府，爬到一户农家的树上掏鸟窝。一不小心弄翻了鸟巢，鸟窝里未孵出的鸟蛋掉下来，正好砸在准备孵化小鸡的鸡窝里。吓的母鸡满院子乱飞，惊的院子里一条大黑狗狂咬乱跳。
沈玄曦对蓝若晴说，那一刻他才深刻的体会鸡飞狗跳这个词语的含义。每次听到沈玄曦讲到这里，蓝若晴都被沈玄曦那夸张的表情逗弄着笑得前仰后合的。
屋子里的农户听到外面的声音，以为是来了偷鸡贼，拎着烧火木棍就追出屋子，吓得沈玄曦跳下树拼命的跑。一边跑一边回头的沈玄曦只顾着逃命，没有看到前面已到了一个十字路口，“砰”的一下撞上了沿路欣赏风景的太子皇甫皓轩。
这一撞不打紧，从打娘胎里就带着奇毒，身体一直虚弱的太子竟然一下子晕了过去。随行的待卫见了，抓住沈玄曦不放，拉着他一起去了最近的医馆。可也就是这一撞，甩掉了后边追赶的农户。
皇甫皓轩还未到医馆就醒来了，坐在舒适的马车中，听随行待卫的描述，才知道自己遇到了这么一件惊奇之事。
待卫们带来了沈玄曦，皇甫皓轩发现这个与自己同龄的小男孩双目透着灵气，眼珠转动着似乎在想着怎样逃脱。
皇甫皓轩不禁有了想要逗弄他的想法，于是他故做威严状，怒道：“就是你撞伤我的？”
沈玄曦自进入马车中，就感觉到这个同自己年龄相仿的少年不怒而威。
不过，他可不怕这个。从小父亲就总是用严厉的态度对待他，他有一百种方法对付呢。
于是他故做可怜状，“公子，对不起，因为我刚才路过一个农家，他家里刚刚遭贼，就把我当作是贼来抓。”说着，沈玄曦硬是挤出了几滴眼泪，“我若是不跑，就会被他们抓住打死的。跑路不看路，是我的错。撞到了您，是我千不该，万不该。但是现下我看您已无大碍，能否饶恕小人？”甩出一把鼻涕，他接着道：“因家母生病，我去城外的感业寺为母亲祈福，告诉她说午时以前回去，现下不知母亲大人在家中有多着急呢！”说完，沈玄曦就坐在车上嚎啕大哭起来。
皇甫皓轩看着沈玄曦在那自说自演，心中不禁觉得好笑。这家伙，演的还真像。心想，我再逗弄他一下，看看他还能演出什么。
“可你把本公子撞伤了，却也是不争的事实。你说，该怎么办吧？不然，我随你一起到府上，看看令尊大人会怎样说，如何？”皇甫皓轩忍住笑，装作一副蛮横无理的样子。
“呃……这个？家母生病之际，相信公子这等明事理之人，不会去打扰吧？”沈玄曦吓的汗都下来了，要是让父亲大人知道他在外面如此胡闹，肯定不会饶过他。先别说抄写什么论语诗经的，更别提让他跪祠堂。

The latest chapter of Wushuang, the legitimate daughter who is not reborn as a queen_Chapter 16 Childlike Interests Page 1_Wu Shuang, the legitimate daughter who is not reborn as a queen, Snow_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 16 Childlike Fun (Page 1)
The reason why Shen Xuanxi became friends with the Crown Prince Huangfu Haoxuan is an interesting thing. Lan Ruoqing had told Shen Xuanxi about this matter countless times. Every time she listened to it as a story, but she never got tired of hearing it.
One day, Shen Xuanxi sneaked out of the house and climbed into a tree at a farmhouse to dig out a bird's nest. The bird's nest was accidentally knocked over, and the unhatched eggs fell down, hitting the chicken nest where the chicks were about to hatch. The frightened hens flew all over the yard, and a big black dog in the frightened yard bit and jumped wildly.
Shen Xuanxi said to Lan Ruoqing that at that moment he deeply understood the meaning of the word "Jiu Fei Dog Dan". Every time she heard Shen Xuanxi talk about this, Lan Ruoqing would laugh so hard because of Shen Xuanxi's exaggerated expression.
When the farmer in the house heard the noise outside, he thought it was a chicken thief and chased him out of the house with a firewood stick. Shen Xuanxi was so scared that Shen Xuanxi jumped off the tree and ran as fast as he could. Shen Xuanxi, who turned back while running, was only focused on escaping, and did not see that he had reached a crossroads ahead, and bumped into the prince Huangfu Haoxuan who was admiring the scenery along the road.
The collision didn't matter, the prince, who had been carrying a strange poison since his mother's womb, and had been weak, suddenly fainted. When the accompanying guard saw it, he grabbed Shen Xuanxi and pulled him to the nearest medical center. But it was this collision that threw away the chasing farmers.
Huangfu Haoxuan woke up before arriving at the hospital. Sitting in a comfortable carriage and listening to the description of the guards accompanying him, he realized that he had encountered such a surprising thing.
When the guards brought Shen Xuanxi, Huangfu Haoxuan found that the eyes of this little boy of his own age were full of aura, and his eyes were moving as if he was thinking about how to escape.
Huangfu Haoxuan couldn't help but have the idea of teasing him, so he pretended to be majestic and said angrily: "You were the one who hurt me?"
As soon as Shen Xuanxi entered the carriage, she felt that this young man who was similar to her own age was calm and intimidating.
However, he is not afraid of this. His father has always treated him with a harsh attitude since he was a child. He has a hundred ways to deal with it.
So he pretended to be pitiful and said, "Sir, I'm sorry, because I just passed by a farmer's house, and his house had just been robbed, so he thought I was a thief and arrested me." As he said, Shen Xuanxi squeezed out a few tears, "If I didn't run, they would catch and beat me to death. It's my fault that I ran without looking at the road. I should never have bumped into you. Absolutely not. But now I think you are fine, can you forgive me?" He shook his nose and continued: "Because my mother is ill, I went to Ganye Temple outside the city to pray for her and told her to go back before noon. I don't know how anxious my mother is at home!" After saying that, Shen Xuanxi sat in the car and started crying.
Huangfu Haoxuan couldn't help but feel funny when he saw Shen Xuanxi talking and acting there. This guy really acted like one. I thought, let me tease him a little more and see what else he can perform.
"But it is an indisputable fact that you injured me. Tell me, what should I do? Otherwise, how about I come to the house with you and see what your father would say?" Huangfu Haoxuan suppressed his laughter and pretended to be arrogant and unreasonable.
"Uh... this? When my mother is sick, I believe that a sensible person like the young master will not disturb her, right?" Shen Xuanxi was so frightened that she was sweating. If her father knew that he was acting like this outside, he would definitely not spare him. Let alone copying the Analects of Confucius, let alone making him kneel in the ancestral hall.
